verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sentry has an Alerts product, Slack and PagerDuty notification-incident integrations, and email alert notifications, which covers the delivery-channel part of the story. The pack contains only page titles and a pricing line, with nothing on how rules are configured or routed. Missing for 10: routing alerts by project, environment, and severity; per-rule thresholds for new issues, frequency spikes, and affected-user counts; in-depth rule configuration docs; and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can route alerts by project, environment, and severity to Slack, PagerDuty, or email with per-rule thresholds — new issue, frequency spike, affected-user count
